plan.summary: Replace the unguarded filesystem read of config/app.json in src/main.py with a bounded configuration error so a missing config produces a clear ConfigurationError instead of a raw FileNotFoundError.
steps: Introduce a ConfigurationError exception in src/main.py to represent bounded configuration failures.
Wrap the config file read/parse in a try/except that catches FileNotFoundError and re-raises ConfigurationError with a descriptive message.
Expose the loaded audience via a load_audience helper and pass it to greeting, keeping behavior identical when config is present.
risks: If the JSON is malformed or missing the audience key, a different exception is still raised; that is outside the absent-file scope of this task.
The hardcoded config path is unchanged, so behavior for present configs is unaffected.

answer.summary: Guard the config/app.json read in src/main.py so a missing file raises a bounded ConfigurationError instead of a raw filesystem exception.

argv: import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; happy=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","src.main"],capture_output=True,text=True); assert happy.returncode == 0 and happy.stdout == "Welcome, traveler.\n" and happy.stderr == ""; temporary=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); environment=os.environ.copy(); environment["PYTHONPATH"]=os.getcwd(); missing=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","src.main"],cwd=temporary.name,env=environment,capture_output=True,text=True); assert missing.returncode == 1 and missing.stdout == "" and missing.stderr == "Lantern configuration is unavailable.\n"; temporary.cleanup()
